Idempotency-Replayed.description: "true" when this response is the stored answer of an earlier request carrying the same Idempotency-Key (the handler did not run again). Absent on the first execution and on a request without a key.

400.description: The request body is malformed or a required field is missing (bad-request), the Idempotency-Key is malformed (idempotency-key-invalid), or a paging parameter is wrong (unknown-query-parameter, invalid-limit, invalid-cursor).

schema.description: RFC 7807 problem document used for every non-2xx response.

code.description: The stable problem slug (for example port-occupied); its replay class is listed in ADR 0006.

schema.title: Problem

404.description: The robot or AS/RS is unknown (robot-not-found, asrs-not-found).

409.description: The AS/RS rejected the command; `detail` carries the reject reason, for example PORT_OCCUPIED, and `code` its slug (port-occupied). Also 409 idempotency-key-reused: the Idempotency-Key was used with a different method, path or body.
